description: Unofficial fork build of HushGram 0.0.17 for Instagram 453.0.0.57.79 (com.instagram.android) with 128 patches: everything in upstream's main plus the fork's own. New: Stop background jobs under Battery (turn off push and push registration while Instagram's notifications are off, stop the background feed refresh, stop background tracking), a glass tab bar whose pill is always fully round, and Save deleted messages working on 453. It hasn't been through upstream's release checks. Read Before you sign in in the README first. Patch the arm64-v8a build of Instagram 453.0.0.57.79, version code 385914557, and keep the manager's signing key so a new build installs over the old one and you stay signed in.
